title: Wait for source-ingest /readyz up to 180s across bounded refresh recreate and restore and preflight
delivery_scope: Source-only: wait for source-ingest /readyz up to 180s (36 attempts x 5s delay, matching docker-compose start_period 120s plus retries) in scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh manage_source_ingest_refresh_runtime for both bounded and restore actions and in execute_bounded_source_refresh_entrypoint before resolve_bounded_source_refresh_active_symbols and check_taiwan_refresh_preflight; raise .github/workflows/dev-tw-market-refresh.yml job timeout-minutes to 60 and Execute bounded Taiwan chip refresh timeout-minutes to 35; wrap non-blocking TAIFEX and FinMind deploy_nonprod_vm.sh invocations inside bash -c '... || exit 0' under run_with_dev_environment_lease.sh; add/update unit tests.
changes: In scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh manage_source_ingest_refresh_runtime, wait for ${SOURCE_INGEST_API_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:18097}/readyz via curl_with_retry with 36 attempts and 5s delay (--max-time 5 --connect-timeout 5) for both action == bounded and action == restore instead of skipping /readyz on bounded and timing out after 12x5s (60s) on restore.

In scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh execute_bounded_source_refresh_entrypoint (refresh-only entrypoint), wait for ${SOURCE_INGEST_API_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:18097}/readyz via curl_with_retry with 36 attempts and 5s delay (--max-time 5 --connect-timeout 5) before resolve_bounded_source_refresh_active_symbols and check_taiwan_refresh_preflight.

In .github/workflows/dev-tw-market-refresh.yml, raise job refresh timeout-minutes from 45 to 60 and step Execute bounded Taiwan chip refresh timeout-minutes from 15 to 35, and wrap the non-blocking TAIFEX and FinMind deploy_nonprod_vm.sh invocations inside bash -c '... || exit 0' under .lease-controller/scripts/run_with_dev_environment_lease.sh so non-blocking failures never quarantine the shared lease heartbeat.

Updated and added unit tests in scripts/test_deploy_nonprod_vm.py and scripts/test_dev_tw_market_refresh_workflow.py covering bounded and restore /readyz 36x5 wait, preflight /readyz 36x5 wait, exit-safe non-blocking TAIFEX/FinMind steps under lease, and updated workflow timeouts (35m/60m).

acceptance_status.1: met: scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh manage_source_ingest_refresh_runtime waits for source-ingest /readyz with 36 attempts and 5s delay (180s matching docker-compose start_period 120s plus retries) for both bounded and restore actions
acceptance_status.2: met: scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh execute_bounded_source_refresh_entrypoint (--refresh-only entrypoint) waits for source-ingest /readyz (36 attempts at 5s) before resolve_bounded_source_refresh_active_symbols and check_taiwan_refresh_preflight
acceptance_status.3: met: .github/workflows/dev-tw-market-refresh.yml sets job timeout-minutes to 60 and Execute bounded Taiwan chip refresh timeout-minutes to 35 and keeps non-blocking TAIFEX and FinMind refresh steps exit-safe inside run_with_dev_environment_lease.sh via bash -c '... || exit 0'
acceptance_status.4: met: unit tests in scripts/test_deploy_nonprod_vm.py and scripts/test_dev_tw_market_refresh_workflow.py cover bounded and restore /readyz 36x5 wait, preflight /readyz wait, exit-safe non-blocking lease execution, and updated workflow timeouts; evidence.json records exact commands and pass counts with hosted_behavior_claimed false
